messages.content: Hi from Northline! Weekly check-in for pt-1008. How'd your blood pressure meds go this week?

Median wait is currently 31 hours. Want me to escalate you?
STOP. That's way too slow for me.
You're opted out. We won't text again. Reach out anytime if you change your mind.
